title: Staying Healthy and Strong with Benny

scenes.description: Morning Exercise and Drinking Warm Water in the Garden
Feeling Under the Weather and Resting in a Cozy Bed
Energetic Kid Smiling with Benny Full of Health and Power

character_line.en: Good morning! Stretching in the garden feels so good! How do you feel?
character_line.zh: 早安！在花園伸展筋骨感覺真舒服！你感覺怎麼樣？

options.en: I feel great, healthy, and strong today!
options.zh: 我今天感覺棒極了，健康又強壯！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 你今天感覺很有活力「healthy and strong」喔！
大口呼吸新鮮空氣，分享你的好精神吧！

character_line.en: Drinking warm water after exercise is important! Why should we drink water?
character_line.zh: 運動後喝溫開水很重要！我們為什麼要喝水呢？

options.en: Drinking water keeps our bodies healthy and strong!
options.zh: 喝水能讓我們的身體保持健康與強壯！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 多喝溫開水可以讓身體健康「keeps bodies healthy」喔！
水分對成長中的小朋友身體非常重要喔！

character_line.en: Oh no, poor Leo is sneezing! What is wrong with him?
character_line.zh: 糟糕，可憐的里歐一直在打噴嚏！他怎麼了呢？

options.en: He has a cold and a bad headache.

options.hint: 看看他打噴嚏摸頭的樣子，他感冒頭痛「has a cold and headache」喔！
描述生病的症狀告訴 Benny 喔！

character_line.en: He should rest well! What warm words can we say to him?
character_line.zh: 他應該好好休息！我們能對他說什麼溫暖的話呢？

options.en: Take good rest and get well soon!
options.zh: 好好休息，祝你早日康復！

options.hint: 祝福生病的朋友早日康復「get well soon」喔！
溫暖關心朋友，祝他好好休息早日康復吧！

character_line.en: Leo took his medicine and slept well! Look, he is smiling again!
character_line.zh: 里歐吃了藥而且好好睡了一覺！看，他又展開笑臉了！

options.en: Yay! He feels much better and well now!
options.zh: 太棒了！他現在感覺好多了，身體也很健康！

options.hint: 開心慶祝他恢復精神「feels much better and well」喔！
看到朋友病好了，大聲歡呼「Yay!」吧！

character_line.en: Eating good food and sleeping early keep us happy! Do you agree?
character_line.zh: 吃好食物與早點睡覺讓我們保持快樂！你贊同嗎？

options.en: Yes! Good habits keep us healthy every day!
options.zh: 沒錯！良好的習慣讓我們每天都健康！

options.en: The desk is made of wood.
options.hint: 肯定良好習慣能帶來健康「Good habits keep us healthy」喔！
贊同 Benny 說的早睡早起身體好喔！
